title: Downtown Mural Tour
includes: We take your photos with your phone or camera
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Houston through its most colorful streets! Our Downtown Mural Tour takes you through the heart of downtown, staying entirely within the downtown area, where vibrant murals showcase the city’s culture and creativity.
With 25–30 standout murals along the way, you’ll have plenty of chances to snap photos and capture quick videos as you go. Your guide keeps things moving so you can enjoy the ride and get great content—all within the 1 hour and 30 minute tour.
Perfect for friends, families, bachelorettes, and celebrations of all kinds, this tour is all about exploring the city, having fun, and leaving with photos and videos you’ll actually want to share.
Tours are conducted by golf cart for a fun and easy ride through downtown. Accommodations can be made for guests with health-related needs—just let us know in advance.
